model: EcoSmart Connect (CO) control (XBOXER XBC, BPS, BOXER), 2026 object list
applies_to: Nuaire supply and extract ventilation units with heat recovery (XBOXER XBC, BPS and BOXER ranges) with the EcoSmart Connect (CO) controller, per the July 2026 operation manual.
summary: The EcoSmart Connect (CO) controller is a BACnet MS/TP device (default MAC address 4). This July 2026 manual lists 207 objects: AVs and multistate values in the 28501-28992 range (unit enable, software setpoint, fan speed command, sensor readings, up to eight RM room modules, configuration and alarms), four schedules and seven trend logs. The object numbering differs from Nuaire's 2022 list, so match the list to the unit's manual.
notes: The list has no read/write column. Access here is inferred: sensor values, statuses, outputs, alarms and trend logs are R; enables, setpoints, commands and configuration are W.
Multistate values are printed with 0-based numbers (0 = Off, 1 = On); listed as printed. Check the live State_Text, since BACnet multistate values normally start at 1.

MV 28677 is printed twice, as PAC Board Alarm (BPS, reverse cycle DX only) and as Sensor Alarm; both rows are kept. IN16 CO2 Sensor (28512) and IN16 Temperature Sensor (28513) are printed as MSV with analogue ranges.
Rows repeated in the source (four schedules, RM200 temperature and humidity) were listed once; the device object row is left out.
RM199-RM206 are up to eight room modules on the controller's sensor bus; their objects only carry values when that module is fitted.
Nuaire's 2022 manual (672040) uses different instance numbers for many objects; that list is kept as a separate entry.

source.title: Ecosmart Connect (CO) Control Operation Manual, BACnet object list

integration.summary: Write MV 28511 Unit Enable to 1 (On) to run the unit, then set AV 28632 Fan Speed Command (0-100 %) and AV 28654 Software Setpoint (12-28 °C). Read the supply, fresh and return air temperatures, MV 28536 Fan Command and the alarm MSVs; MV 28660 resets alarms. Nuaire recommends writing AVs and MSVs at priority 16.
integration.enable: The unit runs when any enable source is active: the Unit Enable MSV (local display or network), volt-free inputs, night cooling, the internal enable schedule, a fan speed override or a room module PIR. When the enable is removed the unit runs on for the run-on time.
integration.remote_sensors: MV 28612 Setpoint Operation picks whether the last changed setpoint wins, software only, or last changed with a timeout.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; default MS/TP address 4 (AV 29506, range 4-127). Baud rate is MV 28507.
Device instance (AV 29505 Device OID) is unique from the factory.
gotchas: Write AVs and MSVs at priority 16. Do not write outputs; if you must for testing use priority 8 and relinquish afterwards.
Priorities 8 and 16 survive a power cycle; other priority levels are cleared.
Instance numbers changed between Nuaire's 2022 and 2026 manuals; confirm against the unit.
